summary: Full backend + frontend testing pass for OG/SSR/inline-expandable feature set. All 19 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_og_and_ssr.py pass (OG PNG 1200x630 <300KB with X-Cache HIT on 2nd fetch, SSR crawler bridge with curl UA returns HTML w/ h1/JSON-LD/isBasedOn, SPA served for Chrome UA, sitemap/robots ok, /api/story returns role + keywords, ADMIN_PASSWORD sourced only from env). Also verified extra endpoints: /api/rss.xml=200 application/rss+xml, /api/admin/verify with correct pw=200 and wrong pw=401. Frontend flows all working: home story-feed loads with 131 rows and 9 filter chips, TldrHero Share digest button shows sonner toast 'Digest link copied' (verified), clicking story-row-toggle expands inline with story-expanded-<id>, key-sources block, source-role-0='SOURCE', source-link-0 external href, share-copy/bookmark buttons present, collapse works, only-one-expanded-at-a-time works, Products filter chip updates URL to ?tag=Products+%26+Tools and narrows to 38 rows, '/' focuses search-input, j+j+Enter expands 2nd row via keyboard. Story permalink page /story/<cat>/<slug> loads: story-headline testid present, absolute og:image points at /api/og/story/<id>.png, og:title/og:description/twitter:card=summary_large_image/canonical present, JSON-LD NewsArticle with isBasedOn+citation arrays, TOPICS and TAGS blocks visible, source role labels rendered visually. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor consistency: /app/frontend/src/pages/Story.jsx uses data-testid='source-list' and no per-source 'source-role-<i>' testids, while StoryRow (inline expanded) uses 'key-sources' and 'source-role-<i>'. Role labels ARE rendered visually on the permalink page so the acceptance is met, but adopting the same testids would make selectors uniform for future tests.
Story permalink KEYWORDS block only renders when story.keywords is non-empty; some existing (pre-enrichment) stories have empty keywords which is expected.
test_credentials: Admin: pulse-admin-9F3k (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, header X-Admin-Password or body.password to POST /api/admin/verify)
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 131 stories in DB
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 19 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_og_and_ssr.py cover OG cards, SSR bridge, sitemap/robots, keywords/role fields, and ADMIN_PASSWORD env sourcing — these plus RSS + admin verify are the regression bar. Frontend inline-expand behavior in StoryRow uses testids story-row-toggle-<id>, story-expanded-<id>, key-sources, source-role-<i>, source-link-<i>, share-copy-<id>, bookmark-btn-<id>. Story permalink page uses different testids (source-list, story-bookmark-btn, share-copy-btn) — same visual role labels though.
